name: When is the best time to schedule a vanity or cabinet installation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time to schedule a vanity or cabinet installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: The best time to schedule a vanity or cabinet installation often depends on your overall project timeline. If it's part of a larger renovation, it's typically done after demolition and rough-in plumbing/electrical, but before final flooring and painting. For a standalone replacement, we can work around your availability. It's always a good idea to book in advance, especially during peak renovation seasons, to ensure your preferred dates.
acceptedAnswer.description: Schedule after demolition and rough-ins in a renovation, or when convenient for standalone projects; book in advance.
